latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Social Proof Optimizer skill for marketing and persuasion scenarios.
- Guides users through assessing and designing effective social proof elements (testimonials, reviews, user counts, etc.).
- Includes structured process to score audience uncertainty and evaluate similarity of proof sources to maximize persuasive impact.
- Supports both application (design/improve) and defense (audit/evaluate for authenticity) use cases.
- Offers context gathering prompts and default assumptions to streamline optimization even with limited initial information.
